stem: After a severe storm, a grower finds broken branches, standing water and prolonged canopy wetness. What is the strongest post-event approach?
choices: Document affected areas, correct safe access/drainage and structural hazards, and increase targeted crop inspection for damage and disease-favorable conditions
Resume normal work without documenting the event
Apply a pesticide immediately without identifying a problem
Focus only on soil moisture and ignore damaged canopy tissue
rationale: Severe-weather response should combine safe access, structural and drainage correction, traceability and targeted post-event scouting rather than a single reflexive treatment.
